title: Crimson & Scarlet
description: Crimson & Scarlet is a series of intimate, small-format paintings exploring close-up fragments of passion, physical devotion, and emotional surrender. Utilizing a strict, focused palette, deep crimson for dark undertones, vibrant scarlet for light, and pure oil white - the collection examines what it truly means to define “soft and pink” through visual language. The series moves fluidly between extreme close-ups of kissing, melting forms, and tactile touches, alongside subtle still-life elements. In each piece, boundaries dissolve: faces merge into singular, fluid masses, and objects become vessels of shared intimacy. By stripping away background context and focusing on the raw mechanics of desire, Crimson & Scarlet isolates the quiet, intense moments where tenderness turns into passion, and identity melts into connection.
